in_sanskrit.name: शर्विकर्ष
in_sanskrit.meaning: God Shiva's power, Lord of the universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्व (Sharva) meaning God Shiva + विकर्ष (Vikarsha) meaning power, Lord of the universe

in_hindi.name: शर्विकर्ष
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिव (Shiva) meaning God Shiva + का (Ka) meaning possessor of + शक्ति (Shakti) meaning power + राजा (Raja) meaning king, Lord of the universe

in_tamil.name: ஷர்விகர்ஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஷிவ (Shiva) meaning God Shiva + விகர் (Vikar) meaning power + ஷ (Sha) meaning possessor of + ஜ (Ja) meaning this + ஹ (Ha) meaning that + க (Ga) meaning great + ில் (il) meaning lord

in_telugu.name: శర్వికర్ష
